key_impacts: ~4.2 million cases and 284,000 deaths reported globally as of 2020-05-11.
Epidemics exceeded or risk exceeding healthcare capacity, including in high-income countries such as the US and Italy.
Poorest quintile faces higher COVID-19 death probability (mean +32%, 8.0%–72.5% range) due to limited handwashing, work-from-home options, and hospital access.
About 2.01 (1.89–2.13) billion people lack access to handwashing facilities globally.
Timing may interrupt planting and harvesting seasons, heightening food insecurity in low-resource settings.
evidence_snippets: COVID-19 has spread globally, with ~4.2 million cases and 284,000 deaths reported as of 2020-05-11.
